trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller may enumerate the branch, tag, PR and revision names of the Git SCM configured on a job is decided by a Job.BUILD permission check at the top of the fill-value-items descriptor handler, before SCMFactory reads the job's GitSCM configuration.

landing_point.why: The advisory names a missing permission check on listing SCM branch and tag names; this handler is the only method that renders those names (index.jelly:15 posts the select box to fillValueItems) and it goes straight to getGitSCMs/generateContents with no check.

fix_sites.module_kind: Stapler descriptor handler in the plugin's main module

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver can wave off the two adjacent internal paths into the same listing - isValid()'s cache refresh (GitParameterDefinition.java:702-709) and the public generateContents() (GitParameterDefinition.java:378) - as unreachable without Job.BUILD, and stop after guarding the descriptor.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The Build-with-Parameters page's own script already POSTs to fillValueItems and must keep receiving values for a user who has Job/Build but not Job/Configure or Administer (git-parameter-select.js:78-83); and a parameter definition with no resolvable parent job must yield ItemsErrorModel.EMPTY rather than NPE, since Utils.getParentJob returns null (Utils.java:18) and both getCustomJobName (GitParameterDefinition.java:669-673) and isValid (GitParameterDefinition.java:693-696) explicitly handle a null job.

O6_input_shapes: HTTP method: GET is rejected, only POST reaches the handler (@POST)
no job ancestor resolved (top-level descriptor URL) -> ItemsErrorModel.EMPTY instead of an NPE
job present with a known param name -> Job.BUILD check, then the ref listing

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second doFill*Items descriptor method (e.g. a revision- or tag-specific fill) that calls generateContents without the permission check or @POST.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The pre-fix body at :728-753 is the obvious template, the plugin already special-cases PT_REVISION and pull-request types, and a maintainer adding a type-specific fill endpoint for the 'needs to clone' flow would copy the unguarded code.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: getAllValueItems() refactored to call JobWrapperFactory.createJobWrapper(getParentJob(this)) + generateContents directly instead of going through the descriptor.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is already a public @Exported accessor whose only purpose is to produce the list; skipping the descriptor round-trip is a natural cleanup that would silently skip the guard.

O10_build.toolchain: Maven with org.jenkins-ci.plugins:plugin parent 6.2116.v7501b_67dc517, jenkins.baseline 2.479 / jenkins.version 2.479.3 (Java 17+); spotless and junit4/commons-lang2 import bans enabled (pom.xml:36-42)
O10_build.project_tests: JUnit 5 JenkinsRule tests; GitParameterDefinitionTest calls the descriptor's doFillValueItems directly about 25 times (e.g. :99, :132, :156) and PipelineTest exercises the parameter through a pipeline; Constants.java:5-8 and PipelineTest point at live github.com repositories, so the suite needs network unless those URLs are localised.

j.j_sites_touched: src/main/java/net/uaznia/lukanus/hudson/plugins/gitparameter/GitParameterDefinition.java (all public paths funnel through the single guard at :728-739)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add job.checkPermission(Item.READ) (or Jenkins.ADMINISTER) inside doFillValueItems without @POST and without the null-job guard, which either still lets read-only users list refs or breaks the Build-with-Parameters page for Build-only users.
